# Aharada Education
> Get Your Wings to Fly. Premier Aviation, Aerospace Engineering, and Industry-Integrated Management Education Platform in India.

## About
Aharada Education (a unit of Prabhu Drone Research and Development LLP) delivers industry-embedded undergraduate and postgraduate academic programs in partnership with NAAC 'A' accredited universities:
- IIMT University (Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, NCR)
- Swami Vivekanand Subharti University (Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, NCR)

All degrees are UGC-recognized and formally valid across aviation, aerospace, defense, corporate, and government sectors worldwide.

## Academic Programs
- **BBA Aviation & Travel**: 3-Year Undergraduate Degree. Airport ground handling, airline ticketing, IATA guidelines, passenger management, cabin operations, air cargo logistics.
- **B.Tech Aerospace Engineering**: 4-Year Professional Engineering Degree. Aerodynamics, flight mechanics, aircraft propulsion, avionics, drone technology, satellite systems.
- **MBA Aviation Management**: 2-Year Postgraduate Leadership Degree. Strategic airline management, aviation law & regulations, airport infrastructure, fleet planning, revenue management.
- **B.Sc Aeronautical Science**: 3-Year Science Degree. Commercial pilot ground training alignment, flight navigation, air traffic management, aircraft instrumentation.
- **BBA Data Analytics & AI**: 3-Year Management Degree. Business analytics, machine learning applications, predictive modeling, data visualization.
- **BBA Entrepreneurship & Innovation**: 3-Year Degree. Startup incubation, venture capital pitching, product management, innovation labs.

## Campus & Infrastructure
- Flight simulators and aeronautical laboratories
- 100+ acre and 250+ acre partner university campuses
- Regular visits to international airports, airline hubs, and MRO maintenance hangars
- 100% placement pathway with 200+ airline & corporate recruiters including IndiGo, Air India, SpiceJet, Vistara, Akasa Air, and Alliance Air.
